reason: Stage 10A has a sound request-scoped Manager/memory and explicit-seed foundation, but the active API does not yet emit the required compact 10A/r1/a1/core lifecycle identity or per-request correlation. Existing registered paths also log or persist raw request/query/user/preference/exception values and enabled Sentry captures raw exception objects. The separately locked langsmith_trace.py now supplies an import-side-effect-free, closed-allowlist, monotonic-latency, failing-sink-isolated helper; Core must wire it at its call-sites and remove unsafe payload logging before final implementation/QA.

requested_changes.request: Wire langsmith_trace.new_stage10a_run_id and emit_stage10a_event at API startup/shutdown, request started/completed/failed, Manager factory created/failed and Manager memory created/failed boundaries. Store only an injectable local sink and immutable clients/settings on app.state; the default sink must be None and must not contact any exporter. Assign exactly one opaque run_id to request.state before downstream execution and reuse it in all events for that request. Use identity stage=10A, stage_revision=1, attempt=1, agent=core and implementation_version=stage10a-r1-a1. Include only fields from STAGE10A_METADATA_FIELDS; include runtime/forecast versions and ticker/as_of/target/horizon/analysis_mode only when already available as canonical compact values. Measure completion/error latency from time.perf_counter; it must be finite and non-negative. Emit failure events before bare re-raise or safe response mapping. A raising sink must never change lifecycle, request, Manager/memory creation, error response or seed behavior. Add focused assertions for event names/order, one run_id per request, distinct concurrent request ids, exact identity, measured latency and failing-sink invariance.

Remove private/raw values from registered Stage 10A runtime logs and persistence without changing business routing. In api/main.py replace log.exception and raw sentry_sdk.capture_exception calls with the compact request event and stable error_code only. In api/routes/analyze.py remove req.user_id and req.query from START logging, do not create unconditional Sentry breadcrumbs, replace log.exception/str(exc) persistence with a stable payload-free error code, and preserve the existing public safe response contract. In memory/manager_memory.py never log task_query, preference values, memory values, user identity or exception text/stack; retain only stable operation/status/count fields. Add PRIVATE_SENTINEL tests using caplog, fake persistence and fake telemetry sink proving request/query/preferences/Manager state/memory values/credentials/exceptions/secrets/brain_reasoning/raw evidence are absent. Changes to api/routes/analyze.py are limited to privacy and observability call-sites; do not alter Stage 10B request schema, business routing, result mapping, persistence structure, progress or UI behavior.

Keep Sentry and LangSmith disabled unless the global OBSERVABILITY_ENABLED flag, the per-exporter flag and the corresponding credential are all present. Make optional exporter initializer failures non-fatal and payload-free: do not log exception text, credentials, DSNs or headers. Do not capture raw exception objects, request bodies or user state; at most export the same compact allowlisted event after explicit opt-in. Ensure Settings-provided credentials are honored without copying them into telemetry. Add offline mocks proving disabled startup does not call initializers, each incomplete gate remains disabled, initializer/sink failures do not fail startup or requests, and no external client/network is contacted. If core/observability.py is not reassigned to Core, the Orchestrator must grant an exact temporary lock or schedule a separate observability-owned repair before PRIMARY_FINAL.

At the repository CLI boundary, optionally emit seed.command.selected with a fresh opaque run_id only after the explicit seed-rag command is selected. Never emit ticker lists, credentials, archive contents or exception text. Preserve the default serve path and all existing tests proving it does not invoke seed. This event must not itself execute or contact seed, database, network or exporters.
